scope: Provider and RunEvent semantic replay protection

checks.name: provider_replay_same_attempt
checks.evidence: same semantic provider event with a new random event id remains one stored event

checks.name: provider_replay_distinct_attempt
checks.evidence: same source id in a different segment/attempt remains a separate event

checks.name: provider_arrival_order
checks.evidence: source arrival order is preserved independently from provider source sequence

checks.name: terminal_protection
checks.evidence: same final replays are dropped; a different final in the same attempt is rejected; retry starts a new attempt

checks.name: tool_and_artifact_replay
checks.evidence: tool invocation and artifact creation do not duplicate on replay

checks.name: sqlite_restart_replay
checks.evidence: SQLite close/reopen keeps the first event and first terminal

checks.name: receipt_conflict_preservation
checks.evidence: identical receipt is ignored; changed receipt becomes a deterministic variant

checks.name: jsonl_fallback_replay
checks.evidence: JSONL event log does not append a semantic duplicate

boundaries: Does not claim Provider exactly-once delivery.
Does not implement dynamic permission revoke or automatic background retry.
Does not compare context compression across models or harnesses.
